reviews.text: Both doctors  and medical staff very helpful and kind

I am so pleased with the care we and our dog received today with her euthanasia appointment. The reception staff, vet and the nurse where all wonderful, special thanks to Chloe and Danny for this care of us humans. It was a very tough day made easier by the team.
Staff is extremely helpful and professional - Price for an Xray is completely unethical...

If I could give no stars I would. I was turned away from this practice after booking to have my dogs 6 month check up with them. I spoke with someone in reception a day prior and was not informed then that I could not be seen, but I had to arrive on the morning of my appointment to be told. The background is that earlier in the year my dog was severely unwell with gastrointestinal issues and we took him to Medivet, Lewisham. The attending vet on the day, Mr Rok Rozic, handled him extremely poorly and left him in a worse state of distress. We then rushed to a different vet and they were able to handle the situation with much better ease and composure. I raised a complaint against the treatment by Mr Rozic and refused to pay for no treatment that was effectively given. Owing to this they transferred my papers to Medivet, Camberwell without notifying me.
Now I wanted to have a 6 month check up for my dog and chose to approach Medivet, Greenwich as that is the next closest vet to us after Lewisham, and we were turned away. Turns out the same person Mr Rok Rozic is also the owner of Medivet, Greenwich. He needed to approve our consult at his clinic and clearly he wouldn’t, although what I was told was that he is in surgery. In my opinion we probably dodged a bullet as I wouldn’t have wanted a consult with him anyway. Added to this, his staff was rude and unapologetic for the situation. The practice itself is poorly maintained and the room that I was taken into to chat with his staff was filled with pet trimmed hair and debris. Wouldn’t recommend them at all.

It was our first visit to Medivet Greenwich, as a first time pet owner I had a lot of questions. We were made to feel at ease, not rushed and felt reassured when leaving, my kitten was even given treats during the consultation so it’s a paws up from him too!
Overcharging and the time it took to refund the difference, plus conflicting advice from different vets at the same practice means we are leaving Medivet Greenwich after 7 years.
Great service, good to go at any time when you have an emergency at night. Good communication with the vets.

I have been using this vet for 18 months. They have become extremely expensive - indeed Solensia injections have been going up monthly for the last 6 months. This month by £12 - the preceding months a little less, but when queried; I was told I should subscribe to some club to stop being ripped off??
I am done, I am changing vet.
This coupled with the very rude receptionists, particularly the older lady with the short hair - has made me decide to leave. When I queried the price increases with her, she curtly replied that "things are going up everywhere" - when I commented not every time I visit for the same product - she rolled her eyes and ignored me. She is aggressively rude and uncaring and is a secondary reason for my departure.
The surgery itself is very run down, dirty and in a poor state of decoration.
Indeed, I have wondered how clean the surgery and care areas are if the customer areas are so uncared for.
It's a shame as the veterinarians and nurses themselves are lovely, but then I suppose they have an interest to be so.
Such a shame.

I’d like to thank to the Medivet Greenwich team. My cockapoo had a complicated abdominal surgery and Dr Antonio Ramirez Vargas and the whole team supported my puppy with their best knowledge for a speedy recovery. I can’t thank enough to them. The recovery took longer than planned but went well and my pup is healthy and feeling well again.

The team at MediVet Greenwich have been looking after one of my cats, Churchill, over the past years. He wasn’t in the best of health and was a frequent visitor due to recurring cystitis. During each visit, the doctors and nurses would perform a very thorough assessment and leave me with detailed instructions on administering medication. A few weeks ago, Churchill became very unwell and needed to be rushed to the clinic. The team performed CPR a number of times but eventually his body has spent his resource and he passed away. Terrible news as it is, it is comforting that he received great care during his lifetime (particularly from Dr Antonio and Dr Sean) in this practice (including in his final moments).

I can highly recommend this practice based on my experience. They are also open on week ends which is an added bonus if you live locally.
Best place, have saved my dog so many times!

We came here seeking urgent help for our bunny. It is already extremely difficult to find an exotic vet, and she was clearly in pain and struggling to breathe when we brought her in.

They suggested taking a blood test to determine whether she had an infection before proceeding with further treatment. In the meantime, we were given Critical Care and painkillers. However, one full week later, we still had not received any information about the blood test results, and no further treatment had been carried out.

We called to explain that the situation was URGENT, only to be told that the vet was off that week and that they could not disclose the results. We asked them simply to email us the results so that we could at least show them to another vet, seek advice, or try to understand what was happening ourselves. They refused to send them.

The delays and lack of communication left us unable to make informed decisions or seek appropriate treatment elsewhere in time. Tragically, our bunny died this week. We will never know whether earlier access to her test results and appropriate treatment could have changed the outcome, but the delays were completely unacceptable in an already critical situation.

What is most upsetting is the complete lack of urgency, communication and compassion we experienced. When an animal is suffering, “the vet is off this week” should not mean that the owner is left without access to critical medical information.

It is particularly upsetting to see a board proudly displaying the pets belonging to the vets and staff. I sincerely hope they treat their own animals with the care, urgency and compassion that our little girl deserved.

We trusted this practice when our bunny desperately needed help. We are devastated by what happened and would not recommend this practice to anyone with an exotic pet.

Our experience is from 2014 to 2023. Victor was amazing with all of our pets, from guinea pigs to dogs. Antonios joined later and treated our dog; he was great too. They are medically knowledgeable, honest about the options we have, not overtest for things that wouldn't affect the final decisions, and can understand the process of bringing my pets on the plane.

We feel that we need to leave a positive review now because there are many negative reviews, which could be a bit biased. We travel extensively around the world with our pets. We have seen many different vets in the US, Canada, and British OT. Medivet Greenwich is the best out of all the ones we have experienced - very knowledgeable, not doing unnecessary invasive tests, honest about the situation not to prolong the animal's suffering, and the most affordable. We bought more medication from Medivet Greenwich as the same drug costs way, way, way more elsewhere.
From making an appointment, arrival and procedure all professional.

We absolutely love and recommend this clinic.
They staff is very friendly, and you can tell they genuinely care about their patients. All our questions are always answered in detail, and we will like everything is thoroughly reviewed and explained. Our dog is in great hands there

We've used these guys for a while now & they've all been great, the fact they actually listen & not just pretend to listen unlike some others. Luna is always looked after & Roc especially was fantastic at keeping us informed pre & post surgery for her. It's a small vet office with big big hearts

The service is great. But it’s brutal for the vet to work all day long in such a stuffy and small room without an aircon! The fan is kind of decorative there Medivet should consider adding a portable aircon not just for humans but furry patients too

Very happy with this Vetinary Practice which is within walking distance. Found a little stray kitten which I kept and they have been great with him. They may not be the cheapest Vet's but they are very efficient and professional. One receptionist a bit offhand,  seems to have left. Others are lovely and a lovely female vetinarian I saw on my last visit was very kind.

I visited Medivet in London and my experience was extremely disappointing and frustrating from start to finish. They immediately recommended X‑rays, blood tests, and even insisted my dog be sedated for the procedures. By the time everything was added up — including the medication they prescribed — the total bill came to over £1,200.

Worst of all, they caused me terrible stress and fear by strongly suggesting the problem could be cancer, making me worry about the worst possible outcome. In the end, after all those tests and expense, the diagnosis turned out to be nothing more than a dislocated toe. Their only solution? Keep my dog confined at home, restrict all movement, and give sedatives for a full month.

Today, weeks later, my dog’s toe is in exactly the same state as it was before I spent all that money. No one from the clinic ever followed up to check on her or offer any real, proper treatment plan — I was just left hanging. What makes it even worse is that when I spoke to other vets the very next day, they had no record of the case and were completely unaware of what Medivet had done or told me.

I feel I was massively overcharged for unnecessary procedures, misled into panic, and given zero effective care. I do not recommend this branch at all — it felt like a business more interested in high fees than in helping pets properly.

Don't roccomend it.
I met two different vets on separate occasions and both times received a great service. Truly appreciate the helped received today 🙏 …

I am submitting an amendment to my previous review, as I wish to wholeheartedly endorse this veterinary practice. I have been a client of this establishment since 2023.

While this is a high-volume and fast-paced veterinary clinic, I have consistently been accommodated for appointments. The past month presented significant challenges for one of my pets, who was diagnosed with cancer. However, she received exceptional care from Dr. Clarisse, who demonstrated remarkable compassion. Dr. Clarisse was highly informative and performed both of my cat's surgeries with outstanding skill. I am confident in her expertise. Her dedication to my pet's well-being extended beyond expectations, and for that, we are deeply grateful. We have also had positive interactions with Rok and Antonio, who are consistently excellent and knowledgeable professionals.

I hold the entire team in high regard; they consistently provide the highest level of assistance. I have developed a strong working relationship with the team, and they have always been highly responsive and effective in caring for all of my cats. I am profoundly thankful for their efforts and place my complete trust in their services.

Service here itself isn’t bad compared to other branches.
I really liked the idea of a candle being lit at the reception to inform others that someone is saying their last good bye and to show respect and empathy, so it’s expected you aren’t loud or obnoxious.
However when we attended to say good bye to our beloved pet, nobody really respected that someone is mourning there and neither staff or clients bothered keeping their tones  down, we could literally hear every word spoken. I’d expect a bit more empathy and respect and eventually your staff to inform your clients to stop talking so loudly.
If you need a vaccination for your pet, cool.
If you’d like to say your last good bye in respectful and peaceful environment, then don’t bother, you’re just a credit card to them and it shows.

Today we had our darling dog put to sleep. The call before to make the appointment was so sensitive and was dealt with so emphatically. Today our appointment arrived and our vet Clarisse was unbelievable. She was kind, compassionate, empathetic there was no rush completely understanding. I can’t thank her enough for the way the whole process was dealt with. I will be forever grateful to her. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts
Friendly staff, prompt service! Our cat was very nervous but Rok was very gentle with him and it was a very good experience as a first visit.
Disappointed to say that after 8 years as a loyal customer the vet could not find five minutes to discuss my pet’s medical condition. I will not be using Medivet again.

Great vets! We're very pleased with the care and advice. Always looking for the best solutions and patiently listening to any concerns or questions.
Appointment availability is also good.

Would've preferred to book the appointment online but that wasn't possible which is a shame. Booking via phone was pretty good anyway, just a personal preference
Very happy with the vet and practice.

Really kind,compassionate vet.
Thank you so much for your swift advice and help

Rok and the team at Medivet Greenwich really took great care of us when we tragically lost our cat over xmas. The care, attention and service we received during this difficult time was full of empathy and compassion and I can't thank them enough for their kindness.

Vet was very nice 😊
My Cats 🐈‍⬛ love ❤️ Him
Thank you 🤩 …

Absolutely phenomenal service from all the team at Medivet Greenwich. Roc took such incredible care of our elderly Jack Russell and we couldn’t have been happier. Seán on reception is fantastically knowledgeable and was such a help with the pet insurance forms. I couldn’t recommend them highly enough. Thank you to all the team there

excellent staff.
lovely ver.  dry thorough and caring.
Friendly and professional service.  Cared well for our cat during the examination
Amazing care.

The staff at Medivet Greenwich are wonderful.  Our dog had injured her nails on a day out in Greenwich.  We were squeezed in as an emergency and received compassionate and professional care. Thank you!

We have started not to trust this Medivet to care about very much about our cat. It just feels it wants us to spend huge sums of money on tests and scans with little idea of what might be wrong. I cannot understand how people can afford to take their pets here as 5 minute consultations are £70 and a blood test approximately £170.

We had an appointment booked for my dog’s treatment, but just half an hour before, I was informed it was cancelled due to the vet being unwell. While I completely understand that illness can happen unexpectedly, I was disappointed with how the situation was handled. I had taken annual leave to be available for the appointment, and no alternative was offered — not even the option to attend another Medivet branch.

I expected better communication and support from a clinic like Medivet.

We moved away from the neighborhood but kept our pets registered with them, really don't mind driving extra miles.

The staff is so attentive! We are very lucky to find this practice

1 - Good local vet, commited staff

2 - If you have a cat they may ask you to wait in a separate area away from the dogs

3 - Ability to keep pets overnight, integrated with most instance schemes
Great practice and love how they manage our little staffy puppy Gaia. Thanks Medivet!
Good service but as with most vets pricey , £300 to get my dogs teeth cleaned £490 if any need to be taken out.

We love Medivet Greenwich! We switched from another popular vet in the area when one of our cats fell really ill and passed away and we felt like we didn’t get the care and attention we needed there. Medivet has been consistently reliable, friendly and never feels rushed. We’ve also used their emergency service in Camberwell and it was excellent. Highly recommend!
Had such a good experience, vet really clearly explained options for travel and gentle with my dog who is very nervous.
My little furry baby has unfortunately some health issues so we fairly regular visitors at the practice. I've been always happy with the care the vets and others staff provided to my dog.

After spending 15 minutes as '1st in que" I had hang up the phone.

Imagine if this was an emergecy, ridiculous!!!
Rok is an exceptional vet who will go an extra mile to help your pet. Highly recommended!
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
Very pleased with the staff and the care of my three pets! Never a problem even in hard situations and they truly care for the wellbeing of my pets!

Just type on YouTube: Medivet Panorama and you will see what these vets are like.

I’ve had a highly disappointing experience with Medivet Greenwich, and I feel compelled to share my concerns.

Firstly, the costs are astronomical compared to the level of service provided. It’s frustrating to constantly have to chase for call-backs, prescriptions, and invoices — basic things that should be handled efficiently by any professional vet clinic.

What’s worse is the apparent lack of care for the animals. When my cat underwent a cystocentesis urine collection, the urine pot wasn’t even closed properly. This led to the test panel being incomplete, an utterly avoidable mistake.

When I brought my cat home from the breeder with obvious symptoms (eye and nose discharge) that later turned out to be calicivirus, no tests or precautions were proposed to check if this posed a risk to my other cat. This neglect for preventative measures is shocking.

To top it off, my cat was diagnosed with chronic kidney disease based on a single sample. Chronic illnesses require thorough, repeated testing to confirm they are stable or worsening over time — a basic standard they failed to meet.

The worst experience was after my cat’s neutering procedure. He was sent home without any anti-inflammatory medication, and later I discovered his spermatic cord hanging out of his scrotum! This level of negligence is unacceptable and alarming.

Overall, I feel let down by the care and professionalism at Medivet Greenwich. For the prices they charge, the service and attentiveness to both the animals and the owners need a drastic overhaul.

I cannot recommend them and urge others to consider other options for their pets' care.
